//: WHAT A SOLAR SYSTEM HOLDS, AND WHAT CAN BE BUILT IN IT (docs/BUILDINGS.md, docs/SYSTEMS.md). A system is a sun, everything that goes round it, and the open space between. THREE KINDS OF THING ARE BUILT. (1) BUILDINGS go in a place's SLOTS and can be upgraded. A place starts with `slots` by its kind (a rock or ice-dwarf of size 1 has `smallSlots`; the system's own world, its HOME WORLD, has its specialization's) and gains more three ways (`slotRules`): by the system's DEVELOPMENT (a slot at each level named in `developmentWorld` for the home world and `developmentBody` for every other place), by the RANK of the house that holds it (`rankWorld`, `rankBody`: title ranks), and by PAYING to clear ground (`clearCost` times the number cleared plus one, up to `clearMax`). `maxWorld` and `maxBody` are the most a place can ever show. The home world takes its own buildings (buildings.json, holdings_ext.json, and the works here with `on: world`) AND the ordinary buildings of its kind, in the same slots; `notHome` keeps a colony off it. A building's level may rise to 3; `upgradeAt` is the development level each level needs, and a level costs the building's cost times the level it leaves. (2) GREAT WORKS (`megastructure: true`) take no slot: every place, the sun and open space included, has ONE SITE for one great work. They cost far more, take many years and are gated by rank. How many a house may raise at once is `greatWorks.capacity`: one for any house, two for the leader of a region, three for a head of state (a consul, the holder of the capital, the head of a state that has left, an archduke), five for an emperor. A great work may be HASTENED: it then goes two years in one, and each year pays both instalments and `hastenPct` in the hundred more. A work with a `feature` can be raised only where that feature is. `on: world` means only the home world. (3) INFRASTRUCTURE is the system's own, not any place's: `infrastructure` lists the tracks, each bought a level at a time (level N costs N times `cost` and takes `years[N-1]`), each level doing `perLevel`. Laying a level adds `development.perLevel` to the system's development at once and raises how far it can grow. DEVELOPMENT is a figure from 0 to 100 for each system (its level is a tenth of it): it creeps up a point a year toward a ceiling (`development.ceiling` and what infrastructure, people and prosperity add), faster on a prosperous world, and falls under siege or revolt. `features` are what make one system unlike another. `bodies` lists the kinds a work suits (terran, ocean, arid, forge, frozen, barren, gas, belt, moon, comet, star, space). `deposit` says what the body must carry. `limit`: body (default), system, house, galaxy. `yield`/`upkeep` are a year's and are multiplied by the building's level; a work on a deposit brings up richness-many. `defense` adds to the system's; `prosperity` moves where the world's prosperity heads; `unrest` is added to its unrest every year; `population` raises the most its world can hold; `legitimacy` and `glory` are given once, when it is finished; `depot` supplies fleets. `colony` is what it takes to settle a system nobody holds.

infrastructure.name: Civil Works
infrastructure.description: Roads, power and water on the home world. The first thing a system needs before it can grow.

infrastructure.name: Habitats
infrastructure.description: Air, water and room: what lets more people live round this sun than its world alone would hold.

infrastructure.name: Orbital Traffic
infrastructure.description: Lifts, tugs, pilots and traffic control. Everything that moves in the system moves faster and pays a fee.

infrastructure.name: Outworks
infrastructure.description: Survey, supply runs and life support for the far bodies: what lets the rest of the system be worked.

infrastructure.name: Defence Grid
infrastructure.description: Pickets, sensors and guns between the worlds, so an enemy is fought before he reaches one.

features.name: Great rings
features.description: Rings of ice a hundred thousand miles across. Whole towns could be strung along them.

features.name: An eternal storm
features.description: One storm, older than the Reach, that never moves and never ends. What it dredges up from the deep is found nowhere else.

features.name: A wreck field
features.description: The hulks of a battle nobody won, drifting among the rocks. Good steel, for whoever will cut it.

features.name: The mother lode
features.description: One rock in ten thousand is nearly pure metal. This belt has a hundred of them.

features.name: Ruins older than the Reach
features.description: Walls under the dust, cut by hands nobody can name. The scholars would pay to be let in.

features.name: Deep vaults
features.description: Caverns a mile down, dry and still: nothing put there would ever spoil, or ever be found.

features.name: A buried sea
features.description: Under the ice, a warm black ocean. People could live there who never saw a sky.

features.name: Singing ice
features.description: The ice here rings when the sun strikes it. Pilgrims come to hear it, and go home quieter.

features.name: A garden country
features.description: A valley a thousand miles long where everything grows. The great houses have always wanted a villa here.

features.name: A capital of the old kings
features.description: A city that ruled before the Reach did, half fallen and wholly remembered. Whoever restores it wears some of its name.

features.name: The great reefs
features.description: Living stone from pole to pole, with room in it for cities.

features.name: The Rift
features.description: A canyon that splits the world. One road in, and a wall of rock on either hand.

features.name: An open mantle
features.description: The crust is thin and the fire is close. A forge built over it would never want for heat.

features.name: One face to its world
features.description: It never turns away. From here every ship that comes or goes is seen.

features.name: A hollow moon
features.description: Mined out long ago, or never solid. A fleet could hide inside it.

features.name: The long comet
features.description: Once in a lifetime it comes in from the dark. The house that greets it is remembered with it.

features.name: A flare star
features.description: The sun here throws fire. What it throws can be caught.

features.name: A companion sun
features.description: A second, smaller sun, far out. Two dawns, and twice the light to harvest.

works.name: Outpost
works.description: A few domes and a landing field: the first thing put on any rock.

works.name: Domed Colony
works.description: A town under glass. Its people are the house's people, and its sons the house's soldiers.

works.name: Settled Sister-World
works.description: A second living world in the same sun's light, settled from the first.

works.name: Terrace Farms
works.description: Hillsides cut into steps and planted to the sky. Grain for the system, and sons for its levies.

works.name: Game Parks
works.description: A continent left wild for the great to hunt across. Who is asked, and who is not, is noticed.

works.name: Sea Farms
works.description: Kelp and shoals penned by the square mile.

works.name: Tidal Mills
works.description: A sea that rises forty feet twice a day, put to work.

works.name: Deep Harbour
works.description: A roadstead where a hull can come down to the water itself and load at a quay.

works.name: Sun Fields
works.description: Collectors to the horizon under a sky that never clouds.

works.name: Caravanserai
works.description: Wells, walls and a market where the desert roads meet.

works.name: Strip Mine
works.description: The crust taken off in sheets and sent up the well.

works.name: Smelter Row
works.description: Furnaces fed straight from the pit, a mile of them.

works.name: Geothermal Tap
works.description: Heat for nothing, for whoever drills deep enough to reach it.

works.name: Ice Works
works.description: Water and air for every station in the system, cut from the ice and sold by the ton.

works.name: Cold Granaries
works.description: Seven years' grain laid down where nothing rots. A world that cannot be starved is a quieter world.

works.name: Penal Colony
works.description: Where the house sends those it will not hang. They dig, and the world they came from remembers where they went.

works.name: Proving Ground
works.description: A dead plain to shell, storm and march across until the levies are soldiers.

works.name: Skimmer Fleet
works.description: Scoops that dive the giant's clouds for helium-3 and come up again, most of them.

works.name: Cloud Habitat
works.description: A city that floats where the air is thick enough to hold it.

works.name: Aerostat Refinery
works.description: Cracking towers hung under balloons the size of towns.

works.name: Belt Foundry
works.description: Rock goes in one end and plate comes out the other, without ever touching a world.

works.name: Prospectors' Exchange
works.description: Where every claim in the belt is bought, sold, mortgaged and fought over.

works.name: Hidden Dock
works.description: A berth among the rocks where no customs man comes. It pays well, and it teaches a world to break the law.

works.name: Rare-Earth Diggings
works.description: Narrow seams, followed a long way down.

works.name: Isotope Pits
works.description: What is dug here goes into warheads. The Senate likes to know who is digging.

works.name: Mass Driver
works.description: A rail five miles long that throws ore into orbit, a load a minute.

works.name: Moon Fort
works.description: Batteries dug into a moon's near face, looking down the throat of anything that comes for the world.

works.name: Hermitage
works.description: A few cells and a chapel a long way from anywhere. The great come here to be seen to repent.

works.name: Observatory
works.description: Far from any lamp, the sky is clear. Learned men come, and they talk.

works.name: Listening Post
works.description: Ears turned on the lanes. Nothing comes into the system unannounced.

works.name: Orbital Batteries
works.description: Guns in high orbit over a sister-world, pointed outward.

works.name: Fleet Anchorage
works.description: Fuel, stores and a safe berth. A fleet may sail further from an anchorage than from a bare world.

works.name: Waystation
works.description: A wheel hung where the lanes meet the system, where caravans rest, refit and gossip.

works.name: Customs Cordon
works.description: Cutters across every approach. Nothing lands that has not paid, and the factors grumble.

works.name: Relay Beacon
works.description: The Reach's news passes through it, and is read on the way.

works.name: Patrol Base
works.description: Corvettes on station out beyond the last world. Raiders go round.

works.name: Minefields
works.description: The approaches sown with things that wait. An enemy comes in slowly; so does everyone else.

works.name: Governor's Palace
works.description: A seat fit to govern from: audience halls, archives, a guard. The world knows where its master lives.

works.name: Forum
works.description: A square where the world does its business and its talking, with the house's name over the colonnade.

works.name: Academy
works.description: Schools of law, engineering and war. Its graduates serve the house first, and remember who taught them.

works.name: Great Temple
works.description: The feasts are kept here, and the house keeps them. A quiet world is a world that is prayed for.

works.name: Barracks Quarter
works.description: A standing garrison, its drill fields and its armouries, inside the walls.

works.name: Spaceport
works.description: Pads, warehouses and a customs house on the ground. Everything the world sells leaves through it.

works.name: Hospital Quarter
works.description: Physicians, clean water and a place to be ill in. Fewer children die, and their parents know whom to thank.

works.name: Mint
works.description: The right to strike coin, and the building to do it in. A house has one, and guards it.

works.name: The Orbital Ring
works.description: A ring round the whole world, with yards, docks and towns along it. The first thing a great house builds to be seen building.

works.name: The Great Stair
works.description: A cable from the ground to the sky. What cost a ship to lift costs a lift ticket.

works.name: The Aegis
works.description: A shield over the whole world. A fleet that means to take it must first sit under its guns for years.

works.name: The Spire City
works.description: One city, a mile high, with a million rooms. Everyone in the system has a cousin in it.

works.name: The Dyson Lattice
works.description: A lattice round the sun that drinks its light. The work of a lifetime, and the purse of a dynasty.

works.name: The Sun Foundry
works.description: Mirrors by the square mile, turned on a furnace that hangs in the sun's own light.

works.name: The Sky Harbour
works.description: A port that rides the giant's high winds, where the tankers fill and the fleets water.

works.name: The Hollowed World
works.description: The largest rock in the belt, mined out and spun: a city with the stone of a mountain for its walls.

works.name: The Fortress Moon
works.description: A moon tunnelled through and armed. A besieger must take it before he may so much as look at the world.

works.name: The Mausoleum of the House
works.description: Where the heads of the house will lie, under a dome that can be seen from its world. A house that buries its dead like kings begins to be taken for one.

works.name: The Lane Gate Anchor
works.description: It anchors a gate on the lanes. Everyone who passes asks leave, and the approach is a fortress.

works.name: The Grand Arsenal
works.description: Docks, magazines and barracks for a whole navy, hung in the dark where no world's guns reach it.

works.name: The Long Cylinder
works.description: A valley rolled into a tube and set turning, with fields on the inside and stars at either end.

works.name: The Lighthouse of the Lanes
works.description: A beacon at a key of the lanes, by which every ship in the Reach sets its course. There is one, and whoever keeps it is asked leave by everyone.

works.name: The Ring Habitat
works.description: Towns strung along the rings like beads, each with the giant filling half its sky.

works.name: The Storm Tap
works.description: A tether let down into the eye, to draw up what the storm has been keeping.

works.name: The Breaker's Yard
works.description: The dead fleets cut up for their steel, hull by hull.

works.name: The Lode Works
works.description: A whole asteroid of metal, eaten from the inside.

works.name: The Great Dig
works.description: The ruins opened, room by room. What comes out of them is talked of in every court.

works.name: The Vault Archive
works.description: Every deed, charter and debt of the house, kept where no fire or fleet will ever reach it. Others pay to keep theirs here too.

works.name: The Sunless Cities
works.description: Cities on the floor of a sea no light has touched, warm and crowded and loyal to whoever keeps the ice whole above them.

works.name: The Ice Choir
works.description: A hall cut into the ice to hold its sound. The pilgrims' road runs through the house's own world.

works.name: The Garden Estates
works.description: Villas let to the great of the Reach. They come for the summer, and they bring their business with them.

works.name: The Old Capital Restored
works.description: The palace roofed again and the old roads opened. Whoever sits here sits where kings sat, and is seen to.

works.name: The Reef Cities
works.description: Towns grown into the living stone, a new street every year.

works.name: The Rift Citadel
works.description: A fortress built across the canyon's mouth. It has one gate, and the gate has never been forced.

works.name: The Mantle Forge
works.description: A foundry sunk through the crust to the fire itself. It will be pouring steel when the house that built it is a name in a chronicle.

works.name: The Moon-Port
works.description: A harbour on the face that always watches the world. Every cargo passes under its guns and through its customs house.

works.name: The Hollow Arsenal
works.description: Docks, magazines and barracks inside the moon, behind miles of rock. Nobody outside can count what is in it.

works.name: The Comet Watch
works.description: A chapel that rides the comet out into the dark and back. Its return is kept as a feast, in the house's name.

works.name: The Flare Harvesters
works.description: Nets flung across the sun's reach to catch what it throws off.

works.name: The Twin Crown
works.description: Collectors round both suns, and a beam between them that lights the system's sky. It can be seen from the next star.
